subject: hoverPickup
pitch:
Category: Vehicle.
Subject: militarized pickup converted to hover thrusters.
Style: low-poly cyberpunk.

spec.name: Hoverjack Technical
spec.description: A militarized pickup truck converted to ride on four vectored hover thrusters, in low-poly cyberpunk style with neon underglow, armor plates and a roof-mounted gun.
spec.layout: Pickup silhouette facing +Z: long sloped armored hood at the front (z 1.2..2.7), a boxy two-door cab with raked windshield in the middle (z -0.5..1.2), an open cargo bed behind it (z -2.7..-0.5) with a pintle-mounted autocannon on a ring. There are no wheels: four large ducted hover thrusters (two front, two rear, outboard of the chassis) hang from short pylons, their bottoms about 0.18 m above the floor, with glowing cyan cores. The chassis belly sits at y=0.55. The lowest points are the thruster ducts and skid plates at y=0. Style: faceted low-poly slabs, chamfered plates, hazard-yellow trim, magenta and cyan neon strips along the sills, light bar and thruster rims, antennas, grime in darker tones on lower faces, glowing parts for lights and cores.

parts.builds: Lower hull and frame: slab chassis from y=0.55 to 1.15 with chamfered sides in hull/hullDark, belly skid plates in armorDark touching y=0.45, side sills with neon magenta strips, hazard-yellow trim stripes, front bumper with ram bar and tow hooks, rear bumper, fender-style wheel-arch armor panels over thruster pylons (pylons themselves belong to thrusters), underglow neonCyan strips under the belly, rivets and panel seams as small parts, license plate and decals in decalWhite.
parts.attaches: Carries cab at cabFloor, bed at bedFloor, thruster pylon roots at thrusterXX mounts (x=±1.15 faces), hood meets cab at z=1.2.

parts.builds: Hood and cab: sloped hood with vents, hood scoop, armor plate overlays in armor, front grille with glowing headlights (headlight, glowing) and neonCyan DRL strips; cab box with raked windshield, side windows in glass with glint streaks, A/B pillar armor, window bars, door seams, handles, side mirrors, roof with light bar (neonOrange and neonMagenta glowing), roof antennas, roof armor plate, interior seats and steering wheel visible through glass, exhaust-free smooth sides with hazard stripe decals.
parts.attaches: Sits on chassis top at y=1.15 (hood front at hoodFront, cab rear wall at z=-0.5 meets bedFloor front edge).

parts.builds: Open cargo bed behind the cab: floor at y=1.15 in hullDark, side walls and tailgate with chamfered armor plating and trim stripes, wheel-arch bulges, ribbed floor, rear taillights (taillight glowing) and a neonMagenta rear strip, roll hoop behind the cab with a mounted spotlight, cargo: two ammo crates in armor with trim, a fuel drum in rust, tie-down hooks, and a gun-mount base ring and pedestal at gunRing (static base only, the gun itself belongs to turret).
parts.attaches: On chassis top at bedFloor; front wall touches cab rear at z=-0.5; pedestal ring top at gunRing.

parts.builds: Four hover thruster assemblies, mirrored left/right and front/rear: each has a short angled pylon strut from the chassis side to a large octagonal ducted fan housing (outer radius 0.55, axis vertical, bottom at y=0.02 so the duct lowest point touches y=0) in hullLight/hullDark with hazard-yellow rim bands, a recessed black inner shroud, a central glowing neonCyan core disc with spoke vanes in metal, neonMagenta glowing rim ring, small vectoring flaps below, hydraulic piston rods, and bolts. Each assembly is parented to its own thrusterXX joint, centred on its mount dropped to the duct centre (y about 0.55).
parts.attaches: Pylon roots meet chassis at thrusterFL/FR/RL/RR mounts on the chassis sides (x=±1.15).

parts.builds: Pintle-mounted autocannon on the gun ring: rotating yaw collar and shield plates in armor with trim edge (on gunYaw), cradle with two side arms, receiver box, twin barrels with perforated shroud and muzzle brakes pointing +Z (on gunPitch), ammo box on the side with a belt of small brass-coloured links, a glowing neonOrange sight scope, a small neonCyan status light, handles and grip bars, and a cooling vent grille. Barrels reach about z=-0.1 from the ring.
parts.attaches: Collar sits on the pedestal at gunRing (y=1.75); yaw joint gunYaw at gunRing, pitch joint gunPitch at [0,2.0,-1.3].
